readme:
# Flux 2 Klein 4B Text to Image

FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, the smallest FLUX.2 model, built for speed. Text to image.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `num_inference_steps` | integer 4–8 | 4 | More steps add detail and time. |
| `output_format` | `jpeg` / `png` | `png` | Output file format. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | `16:9` | Output shape. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

$0.008 per image.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.008 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Write subject, setting, composition, style, then light.
- Quote any text that must appear.

## Limits

- One output image per request.

## Also on SandBase

Other FLUX.2 endpoints: `bfl/flux-2/max`, `bfl/flux-2/pro`, `bfl/flux-2/flex`, `bfl/flux-2/dev`, `bfl/flux-2/klein/4b/edit`.
